about: Intro track IN-1: the prepared first run, written by hand (docs/phases/intro-track.md section 5; logic/first-run.js; logic/run-start.js runStartPrepared). New game's crash lands you on its landing (IN-5). Its map is these nodes, numbered row by row and lane by lane (to: the next row's nodes it leads to); each place is still made by mapgen from the run's seed and the node's number, so a mapgen change moves them (tools/test/first-run.test.mjs keeps a snapshot). Lane 0 is the southern one. A node may pin its wild Billies (wild: levels, how many, the species, or by the starter's line: the starter's counter type), its route trainers (trainers), a waystation's event, a town's size, a mini-boss's or the boss's leader (the arena's theme and the mini-boss's team type) and levels over its row (up). boss is the bosses.json bot on the boss node; plant the Perk planted in the mini-boss's pick (the aha). crash: the crash site on the landing, offsets in metres from the landing's mast (x east, z north, turned as the mast is; rot degrees past the mast's): the props put down (the wreck: a stand-in until IN-3's wreck prop lands) after clearing clear metres round each spot, and the spots IN-5's cutscene stands on. Balanced with tools/test/sim/run-sim.mjs --prepared to a win rate of about 20% (the owner).

nodes.note: the crash site: nothing wild by the wreck
the catch: a weak, catchable wild one
the fight: the starter's counter type
one leader, doubles: two Psychic Billies, even against every starter; the pick after it holds the plant
the Retrieval Scout; the leader only themes its arena
